title: Ask the Right Question
description: Choose questions that fit a situation, ask for missing information, turn answers into questions, and create useful questions of your own.
learningFocus: Choose and form who, what, where, when, why, and how questions that fit a picture, answer, or situation.
Ask relevant questions to learn missing information and participate in everyday conversations.
adultGuidance: Read each prompt aloud and let your child answer by speaking, pointing, drawing, or writing. Page 1 has one best question for each situation, which you can check together. On pages 2 to 4, accept any question that asks for the missing information or fits the answer, and praise questions that would really help in everyday conversation.
keywords: who what where when why how questions
